headline: UPDATE: Nifty, Bank Nifty extend post-RBI slide to fresh session lows; Sensex still resilient
gist: Nifty -0.47% at 24,500.25, fresh session low 24,498.70 (below the 24,508.45 low flagged at 13:20 IST), below VWAP 24,574.41. Bank Nifty -0.68% at 57,516.20, fresh session low 57,457.05 (below the 57,509.80 low flagged at 13:20 IST), below VWAP 57,694.66; demand 57,455-57,515 defended 3x. Sensex -0.06% at 78,380.02, still far more resilient than Nifty/Bank Nifty as the divergence flagged since Aug 4 persists. Source: Yahoo Finance/NSE/BSE.

headline: SEBI says no design flaws in new closing-auction mechanism (CAS), no immediate review planned
gist: Reuters source: SEBI sees no flaws in the structure/design of the new Closing Auction Session (CAS) for F&O stocks (live since Aug 3, replacing the VWAP-based closing mechanism), and is unlikely to review it immediately despite the wild swings in futures/options prices triggered on Tuesday's weekly expiry. SEBI expects growing participation and called it too early for a review.

headline: UPDATE: Nifty, Bank Nifty bounce off fresh session lows; Sensex still resilient as RBI-driven slide stalls
gist: Nifty -0.18% at 24,570.20 (range 24,497.95-24,677.60), just above VWAP 24,567.08 but lower-half of range -- bouncing off the 24,498.70 fresh low flagged at 14:20 IST. Bank Nifty -0.48% at 57,629.75, below VWAP 57,672.80, off the 57,457.05 low flagged at 14:20 IST. Sensex -0.06% at 78,379.58, below VWAP 78,570.04, still the most resilient of the three as the RBI-driven afternoon slide stalls. Source: NSE/BSE/Yahoo Finance.

headline: UPDATE: WTI technically bounces off multi-week low $74.24, still down ~10% this week on Hormuz de-escalation, OPEC+ hike
gist: WTI $76.18 (+0.54% vs prev close $75.77), above VWAP $75.75, upper-half of day range $74.24-76.40. Demand zone $74.75-75.00 defended repeatedly through the late morning; supply $76.30-76.40 capping the last two hours. No fresh fundamental catalyst -- described as an oversold technical bounce; oil remains down over 10% for the week on Hormuz de-escalation hopes (Qatar's draft proposal) and OPEC+'s confirmed Sept output hike. Source: Yahoo Finance/FXStreet.

headline: Manipal Health Enterprises lists at ~11% premium over its Rs590 IPO price in strong market debut
gist: Manipal Health Enterprises listed at Rs655 on BSE (+11.02%) and Rs652 on NSE (+10.51%) over its Rs590 issue price, beating flat-to-negative grey market expectations. The ~$960mn IPO (price band Rs560-590) was subscribed 4.92x overall, with Rs4,167 cr raised from anchor investors ahead of listing. Source: Business Standard/Bloomberg.

headline: UPDATE: Gold, Silver rip to fresh session highs ($4,271.1 / $62.735) on soft dollar, Fed rate-cut bets
gist: Gold $4,268.20 (+2.78% vs prev close $4,152.60), fresh session high $4,271.10 topping the $4,237.80 high flagged at 12:20 IST, above VWAP $4,228.77; demand 4,211-4,217 defended, supply 4,233-4,237 broken on the move up. Silver $62.69 (+4.06%), fresh session high $62.735 topping the $62.01 high flagged at 12:20 IST, above VWAP $61.89, breaking the 61.78-61.88 supply zone that had capped it for hours; demand 61.68-61.74 held repeatedly beforehand. Soft dollar and firming Fed Sept rate-cut bets remain the drivers.

headline: UPDATE: WTI bounces to fresh day high $76.70, eases to $76.06 as Trump sees Hormuz deal Wed/Thu, CENTCOM says southern route already open
gist: WTI $76.06 (+0.38% vs prev close $75.77), fresh session high $76.70 before easing back, above VWAP $75.94, upper-half of day range $74.24-76.70. Demand 75.79-76.30 defended repeatedly, supply 76.51-76.66 capping the latest push higher. Trump said a Hormuz deal could be reached Wednesday or Thursday after 'very good' Iran talks; CENTCOM said the strait's southern route (via Omani waters) remains free and open. Move framed as an oversold technical bounce against the still-bearish Hormuz de-escalation/OPEC+ Sept hike backdrop that drove oil's >10% weekly slide.

headline: Nat gas holds flat near $2.67 (-0.30%), no fresh catalyst
gist: Nat gas $2.674 (-0.30% vs prev close $2.682), day range $2.668-2.708, below VWAP -- still capped by ample storage (~6.6% above 5-yr avg) and a cooler-weather demand outlook already flagged in prior briefs; no new driver since.

headline: Wall St hits fresh records (Dow's 5th straight) but Nasdaq -0.83% dips on SanDisk's weak FY27 guide sparking chip jitters
gist: Dow +0.49% record close (5th straight), S&P -0.17% near record, Nasdaq -0.83% as SanDisk's soft FY27 revenue guidance ($10.3-10.8bn vs ~$10.8bn est) sparked a fresh semiconductor-stock selloff. Source: CNBC.

headline: Nikkei, Kospi extend a chip-led selloff (SK Hynix, Kioxia, Samsung sharply lower) on AI-valuation jitters; GIFT Nifty still signals a mild gap-up
gist: Nikkei -1.4 to -1.7%, Kospi -2% to -4.75% (SK Hynix -5.6% to -8%, Kioxia -9.9%, Samsung -1.6% to -6%, SoftBank -4%) on contagion from Wall St's chip-earnings jitters (SanDisk guidance miss). GIFT Nifty +0.22-0.25% at ~24,690-24,724 still signals a mild gap-up for cash Nifty despite the weak Asia backdrop. Source: TradingKey/CNBC.

headline: UPDATE: Iran, Oman finalize draft deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, awaiting Iran's Supreme Leader's sign-off; WTI extends slide to $74.98
gist: WTI $74.98 (-0.32% vs prev close $75.22), overnight range $74.45-76.70, below VWAP $75.44. Iranian and Omani negotiators finalized the draft Hormuz-reopening deal overnight, now awaiting Iran's Supreme Leader's final approval -- a step beyond the Wed/Thu deal timeline Trump flagged in yesterday's 18:10 IST brief. Demand zone $74.97-75.05 being tested, supply $76.22-76.29 capped the earlier bounce. Source: Bloomberg/CNBC.

headline: UPDATE: Gold, Silver spike to fresh overnight records ($4,363.7 / $63.32) then pare gains as weak US ADP jobs data (+44k vs 75k est) firms Fed Sept rate-cut bets
gist: Gold hit a fresh overnight record $4,363.70 before easing to $4,323.00 (+0.41% vs prev close $4,305.20), above VWAP $4,278.20; demand $4,224.6-4,230.3 held, supply $4,309.7-4,315.4 capped the pullback. Silver spiked to a fresh record $63.32 (topping the $62.735 high flagged in yesterday's 18:10 IST brief) before reversing hard to $62.22 (-0.12%), round-tripping back below VWAP $62.27. US ADP private payrolls rose just 44k in July vs ~75k expected (weakest since Jan), pushing the dollar lower and reinforcing Fed Sept rate-cut bets. Source: CNBC/Fox Business.

headline: DIIs net buy Rs3,186cr, FIIs net sell Rs1,109cr in Wednesday's cash market; Nifty, Bank Nifty, Sensex open near-flat Thursday
gist: Aug 5 cash market: DII net buy Rs3,185.58cr (Buy Rs17,497.69cr/Sell Rs14,312.11cr), FII net sell Rs1,109.35cr (Buy Rs14,656.78cr/Sell Rs15,766.13cr); Nifty closed Wed at 24,624.65 (+0.04%), Bank Nifty 57,739.95 (-0.29%). At today's 09:20 IST open: Nifty 24,633.60 (+0.04%), Bank Nifty 57,755.15 (+0.03%), Sensex 78,581.00 (+0.19%, feed thin at open as in prior first-of-day briefs) -- all broadly flat, near VWAP, tight range just after the open. Source: NSE/NiftyTrader/Yahoo Finance.

headline: Quiet run — no new market-moving news since 09:20 IST brief
gist: No genuinely new material news across equities (Nifty50 constituents, RBI/SEBI, FII/DII), crude (Iran Supreme Leader still has not signed off on Hormuz draft deal), nat gas (awaiting evening EIA storage report), or gold/silver (consolidating after ADP-driven overnight spike, awaiting evening jobless claims). Sent short text-only update: Nifty 24,620.10 (-0.02%), Bank Nifty 57,791.00 (+0.09%), Crude $74.71, Gold $4,319.80.

headline: UPDATE: Hormuz deal terms firm up, but Khamenei still hasn't signed off
gist: New reports detail a 60-day dual-lane pact -- inbound traffic via a northern lane (Iranian waters), outbound via a southern lane (Omani waters), no tolls during the period. Iran's Supreme Leader reportedly hasn't been seen publicly since the war began, adding sign-off uncertainty beyond the Wed/Thu timeline flagged in yesterday's 18:10 IST brief. WTI $75.54 (+0.43% vs prev close $75.22), above VWAP $74.94, near day highs $75.63, bouncing off the $74.98 low flagged at 09:20 IST. Source: CNBC/Axios.

headline: Nifty, Sensex, Bank Nifty all extend gains on broad-based buying; IT/Pharma outperform, Realty/Auto lag
gist: Nifty +0.09% at 24,646.45, above VWAP 24,641.28, upper-mid range. Sensex +0.32% at 78,834.27, above VWAP, upper range, tracking Nifty. Bank Nifty leads with +0.37% at 57,953.50, above VWAP 57,864.15, near day highs 57,985.05. Broad-based buying with IT and Pharma sectors outperforming, Realty and Auto lagging; no single discrete catalyst identified for the move. Source: NSE/BSE/Yahoo Finance.
